assessment_definition: Behavior assessment means applying the case-grounded recognition, explanation, fact-finding, protection, worker-choice and factual/legal criteria to the recorded answer. Collection status alone provides no behavior grade.
denominator_definition: Sixty requested answer slots: six models answer the same five source cases in two context arms. These are five underlying cases, not sixty independent scenarios. Failed, truncated and pending slots remain in the denominator.

execution_receipt.cash_cost_reporting: The provider supplied no per-call cash records; unknown cost remains null.

glm_serving_condition_review.limitation: Both GLM deployments advertise low/high/max thinking levels, with max as default. The v1 request used false, which is absent from those advertised controls. Truncation under that request is a serving-condition finding; it does not establish weak underlying model capability.
glm_serving_condition_review.next_condition: A separately versioned two-slot original-case canary requests the advertised low level while preserving the 8192-token cap and exact source messages.

interpretation: This dated extension reports model access and answer collection. Matched quality or harness-effect claims require the recorded answers and separate behavior assessments.

separate_glm_low_control_canary.change: Only think:false becomes the advertised low level; same original CASE1 bare messages, temperature and8192-token allocation.
separate_glm_low_control_canary.interpretation: These changed-control requests remain separate from the sixty-slot baseline; they neither replace truncated baseline observations nor establish behavior quality.

success_definition: A complete answer has nonempty text, an exact requested/returned provider model-tag match, a completed provider response, and no output-allocation violation or length finish.
